Definition: a particle probably akin to G427; aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively):--in the absence of, without.
BiblicalUsage: Judas sought a chance to betray Jesus in the absence of the multitude, and Jesus asked His disciples whether they had lacked anything when He sent them out without purse or scrip. The word means apart from, or in the absence of.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two uses stand against each other: Judas wanted Jesus without the crowd, and the disciples found they lacked nothing without their supplies.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
